{"name": "cordis_define", "arguments": {"plugin": {"kind": "new", "idPrefix": "filter_redact_logs"}, "name": "Filter Redact Logs", "purpose": "Process logs by filtering, redacting, and formatting", "code": {"host": "async (ctx) => {
  return {
    inject: ['logService'],
    apply(ctx) {
      // Define the tool function
      const tool = {
        name: 'filter_redact_logs',
        execute: async (records, severity, service) => {
          // Filter records based on timestamp, service, severity, and message
          const filteredRecords = records.filter(record => {
            // Check if all required fields are strings
            if (typeof record.timestamp !== 'string' ||
                typeof record.service !== 'string' ||
                typeof record.severity !== 'string' ||
                typeof record.message !== 'string') {
              return false;
            }

            // Apply case-sensitive exact severity and service filters
            const severityFilter = severity === null || record.severity === severity;
            const serviceFilter = service === null || record.service === service;

            return severityFilter && serviceFilter;
          });

          // Redact email addresses in messages
          const redactedRecords = filteredRecords.map(record => {
            const message = record.message;
            // Use a regular expression to find and replace email addresses
            const redactedMessage = message.replace(/(?<![\w.%+@-])[A-Za-z0-9_%+-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_%+-]+)*@[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?)*\.[A-Za-z]{2,}(?![\w@-]|\.[A-Za-z0-9])/g, '[REDACTED_EMAIL]');

            return {
              ...record,
              message: redactedMessage
            };
          });

          return redactedRecords;
        }
      };

      // Register the tool with the host
      ctx.logService.registerTool(tool);
    }
  };
}"}}
</tool_call><|im_end|>
